$comment: Machine-readable critical-journey matrix (Phase 2). Human-readable narrative/audit trail: docs/tests/CRITICAL_JOURNEYS_MATRIX.md. Schema + evidence rules enforced by src/tests/critical-journeys-matrix.test.ts: every AUTOMATED_TEST_PASSED entry must cite at least one evidence path that exists in the repo. Statuses: AUTOMATED_TEST_PASSED (cited automated tests exist and pass in CI), IMPLEMENTED (behaviour exists in code, insufficient direct test evidence), MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED (needs a human), EXTERNAL_ACCESS_REQUIRED (needs dashboard/provider access this repo does not control), NOT_VERIFIED (unknown/unproven — the honest default), BLOCKED (needs a product/design decision first).

journeys.name: Email registration
journeys.preconditions: No existing account for the email
journeys.expected: Account created; user directed toward verification/onboarding
journeys.notes: E2E covers post-signup redirect only; full browser→DB registration runs against staging via deploy-staging.yml.

journeys.name: Email verification
journeys.expected: Account marked verified; sign-in permitted
journeys.notes: Delivered and processed entirely by Supabase; needs one manual staging pass with a real inbox.

journeys.name: Email sign-in
journeys.expected: Session established; routed to /advisor or /onboarding

journeys.name: Invalid credentials rejected
journeys.expected: Clear error; no session; no account lockout surprise
journeys.notes: 'shows error toast on sign in failure' covers the rejection UI path with the provider mocked at the auth-hook boundary.

journeys.name: Password reset
journeys.steps: Forgot password → email link → /auth/reset-password → set new password
journeys.expected: Password changed; old password invalid
journeys.notes: Was broken (PKCE ?code= links rejected; 6-char length check); fixed 2026-07-14 with 5 regression tests. Email delivery leg still needs one manual staging pass — hence manual_required despite the automated pass.

journeys.name: Expired password-reset link
journeys.expected: Explicit invalid-link message; path to request a new link
journeys.notes: Invalid-link handling is unit-tested; the specific expired-token variant (Supabase-side rejection) needs one manual staging verification.

journeys.name: Google sign-in initialization
journeys.expected: Redirect toward provider with correct params

journeys.name: Google callback success
journeys.expected: Session established; routed by onboarding state
journeys.notes: Provider boundary mocked; real Google account selection remains MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED (see auth-google-real-account).

journeys.name: Google cancellation
journeys.expected: Recoverable 'cancelled' message; no broken state

journeys.name: Google callback failure
journeys.expected: Explicit recoverable error; retry path

journeys.name: New Google user
journeys.preconditions: Google identity with no existing account
journeys.expected: Account + core.users row created; routed to onboarding
journeys.notes: 'routes incomplete user to onboarding' covers the routing decision with provider mocked.

journeys.name: Returning completed Google user
journeys.expected: Routed to intended destination (/advisor)

journeys.name: Returning incomplete Google user
journeys.expected: Routed to /onboarding, not /advisor

journeys.name: Existing password account using the same verified Google email
journeys.preconditions: Email/password account exists; Google identity with same verified email signs in
journeys.expected: Deliberate, documented behaviour (link or explicit error) — currently undefined by the codebase
journeys.notes: No identity-linking logic exists in the repo; the outcome depends on the Supabase project's manual-linking setting. Confirm dashboard setting, decide behaviour, then test.

journeys.name: Session expiry
journeys.expected: Graceful re-auth prompt; no silent data loss
journeys.notes: Only the admin recent-auth variant is tested (test_stale_session_forbidden); the general user-session-expiry UX has no direct evidence.

journeys.name: Sign-out
journeys.expected: Session cleared; protected routes redirect to landing
journeys.notes: Unit-level only; no E2E asserting post-signout route protection.

journeys.name: Open-redirect rejection
journeys.expected: External/absolute redirects rejected; safe default applied

journeys.name: Real Google account selection (production-shaped)
journeys.preconditions: Staging with real Google OAuth client
journeys.steps: Full non-mocked Google flow on staging
journeys.expected: End-to-end success with a real Google account
journeys.notes: Automated tests mock only the provider boundary by design; the real-provider pass is a human step per release.

journeys.name: New account enters onboarding
journeys.expected: Onboarding step 1 shown

journeys.name: Incomplete user cannot access /advisor
journeys.expected: Redirected to /onboarding

journeys.name: Direct-route bypass is blocked
journeys.steps: Hit every protected route directly by URL
journeys.expected: All protected routes redirect to onboarding
journeys.notes: Gate is client-side routing plus RLS/JWT server-side; the server-side halves are covered by backend auth tests and RLS DB tests.

journeys.name: All steps save correctly
journeys.expected: Each step persists (steps 1–4 upsert user_profiles; step 5 persists goals at submit)
journeys.notes: Was a real gap (steps 1–4 were React state only) — fixed 2026-07-14 with per-step upserts + tests.

journeys.name: Back navigation preserves valid state
journeys.steps: Advance then go back; edit; advance again
journeys.expected: No data loss or corruption between steps
journeys.notes: No direct test asserts backward-navigation state preservation.

journeys.name: Refresh does not silently destroy completed progress
journeys.expected: Resumes at first incomplete step
journeys.notes: Tests: 'starts fresh', 'resumes at step 3', 'resumes at step 5'.

journeys.name: Duplicate submission is idempotent
journeys.expected: Exactly one completion; no duplicate goals rows
journeys.notes: isSubmitting guard + onboardingComplete redirect exist in Onboarding.tsx, but no test exercises a double-fire or two-tab race.

journeys.name: Partial failure does not create inconsistent rows
journeys.expected: User sees error; retry possible; no half-completed state that locks the account
journeys.notes: No test simulates a mid-flow write failure.

journeys.name: Completion changes onboarding_complete correctly
journeys.expected: onboarding_complete=true set once; routed to /advisor
journeys.notes: Exactly-once semantics under a two-tab race are untested (see onboarding-duplicate-submit).

journeys.name: Returning completed user does not repeat onboarding
journeys.expected: Redirected away; no state clobbering

journeys.name: Missing core.users profile is repaired or recoverable
journeys.preconditions: auth.users exists but core.users row missing
journeys.steps: Sign in with orphaned auth account
journeys.expected: Row repaired or explicit recoverable error (never a silent broken app)
journeys.notes: Orphan cleanup handles the reverse direction (core rows without auth). The missing-core.users-on-signin path has no direct evidence.

journeys.name: Create conversation
journeys.expected: Conversation row created and listed

journeys.name: Send first message / receive streamed response
journeys.expected: User message persists; assistant reply streams and persists

journeys.name: Refresh and reload conversation
journeys.expected: Full history reloads in order
journeys.notes: Reload-after-refresh has no direct automated evidence.

journeys.name: Pagination of chat history
journeys.expected: Bounded, keyset-paginated reads; no unbounded scans
journeys.notes: Bounded, paginated chat retrieval implemented for #212 (commit 0fe8277).

journeys.name: Concurrent submission prevention
journeys.expected: Second submit blocked until first settles
journeys.notes: isSendingRef guard + disabled composer exist in Advisor.tsx; Advisor.tsx has zero test coverage — needs a properly scoped test file.

journeys.name: Duplicate-request idempotency
journeys.expected: One turn recorded; no duplicate charge or message

journeys.name: Provider timeout
journeys.expected: Explicit failure state; turn reconciled; retry possible
journeys.notes: Stale-turn reconciliation covered; a live in-flight timeout drill remains a staging exercise.

journeys.name: Provider rate limit
journeys.expected: 429 with clear message and retry-after; no silent drop

journeys.name: User cancellation mid-stream
journeys.expected: Stream stops; turn state honest; no orphaned 'generating' UI
journeys.notes: Reconciliation would eventually mark the turn stale, but no test covers deliberate cancellation.

journeys.name: Backend unavailable
journeys.expected: Clear error banner; app remains usable; retry after recovery
journeys.notes: sendError banner exists in Advisor.tsx; untested (Advisor.tsx has no test file).

journeys.name: Retry after failure
journeys.expected: Retry reuses the original user message; no duplicates
journeys.notes: No retry UI exists; retry_of_request_id column is never populated; manual retype creates a duplicate user message because the user-message write precedes the AI call with a fresh idempotency key. Needs a design decision before implementation (documented in CRITICAL_JOURNEYS_MATRIX.md).

journeys.name: Partial stream interruption
journeys.expected: Partial content handled honestly; turn reconciled
journeys.notes: Reconciliation covers the persistence half; the browser-side rendering of an interrupted stream is untested.

journeys.name: No destructive chat-history reads
journeys.expected: Reads never mutate or truncate history
journeys.notes: Bounded read-only retrieval enforced since #212.

journeys.name: Failed messages remain represented honestly
journeys.expected: Failure visible (not shown as a normal successful turn, not silently vanished)
journeys.notes: Turn-state machine is tested server-side; the UI representation after reload is not directly asserted.

journeys.name: Valid buy
journeys.expected: Journal entry + position + history persist; totals correct
journeys.notes: Persistence was severely broken (auto-fund warnings treated as fatal, rebuild discarded) — fixed 2026-07-14 with regression tests.

journeys.name: Valid sell
journeys.expected: Position closed; P&L recorded; history updated

journeys.name: Invalid symbol
journeys.expected: Clear rejection; nothing persisted
journeys.notes: No direct test found for the invalid-symbol rejection path.

journeys.name: Invalid / zero / negative quantity
journeys.steps: Submit trade with qty ≤ 0 or non-numeric
journeys.expected: Rejected at UI, API and DB constraint layers
journeys.notes: DB-level positive-value constraints (#207) tested against real Postgres, including TestPositiveValueConstraints.

journeys.name: Insufficient cash
journeys.expected: Current design intentionally auto-funds (unlimited virtual capital, recorded as a warning); a budget wall would be a product change
journeys.notes: Auto-fund behaviour is deliberate and tested; whether to replace it with rejection is a pending product decision — do not assume either way.

journeys.name: Overselling prevented
journeys.expected: Rejected at DB level, including race conditions
journeys.notes: TestOversellProtection includes the concurrent-sell race (test_concurrent_sells_cannot_both_pass) against real Postgres.

journeys.name: Concurrent orders
journeys.expected: Serialized safely; invariants hold

journeys.name: Duplicate request
journeys.expected: One order recorded
journeys.notes: No idempotency-key mechanism found on the paper-trading write path; double-submit protection is UI-level only. Needs verification and likely a test.

journeys.name: Market-data unavailable / price unavailable
journeys.expected: Explicit availability metadata / 502-503 semantics; snapshot fallback; never fabricated prices
journeys.notes: Known hardening gap: no code-level maximum-snapshot-age gate on trade execution — trades execute against snapshots of any age. Operational threshold (one trading day, then owner decision) documented in docs/runbooks/market-data-unavailable.md; a code-level gate is a candidate product change, not assumed.

journeys.name: Transaction rollback on partial failure
journeys.steps: Force a failure during state rebuild
journeys.expected: Journal remains source of truth; rebuild retryable; no corrupt partial state

journeys.name: Correct holdings and available cash
journeys.expected: Positions, market value, P&L, invested capital, account value all correct

journeys.name: Correct audit trail
journeys.expected: Every order traceable in trade_journal with timestamps

journeys.name: Load course catalogue / open course / open lesson
journeys.expected: Content renders; navigation works

journeys.name: Record progress / complete lesson
journeys.expected: Progress + best score persisted
journeys.notes: E2E drives the quiz flow; the persistence assertion (row written with correct status) is not directly verified.

journeys.name: Resume progress / reload persistence
journeys.steps: Reopen lesson in a new session
journeys.expected: in_progress/completed status and best score restored
journeys.notes: Implemented via getUserLessonProgress/getBestQuizAttempt in AcademyLesson.tsx; zero test coverage (749-line component, needs its own scoped session).

journeys.name: Missing content
journeys.steps: Open bad slug; force load exception
journeys.expected: No crash; redirect or explicit 'Lesson not found'
journeys.notes: Invalid slug silently redirects to /academy; load exception shows explicit error screen. Untested; minor UX inconsistency documented.

journeys.name: Unauthorized content access
journeys.expected: RLS denies cross-user reads/writes
journeys.notes: RLS policies exist; academy-schema-specific RLS assertions were not located in the DB test suite — verify and add.

journeys.name: Update profile
journeys.expected: Row updated; UI reflects change after reload
journeys.notes: No direct test found for profile update round-trip.

journeys.name: Suspend account / restore account
journeys.steps: Admin suspends; user restores via restore endpoint
journeys.expected: Suspension enforced; restore reactivates with audit records; mismatched/non-suspended restore rejected
journeys.notes: Restore endpoint added in PR #245 with rejection cases (non-suspended, email mismatch, missing user) and audit assertions.

journeys.name: User-initiated deletion request + typed confirmation + recent auth
journeys.steps: Request deletion → typed confirmation → recent-auth check
journeys.expected: Stale sessions rejected; typed confirmation required; deletion recorded with audit
journeys.notes: test_stale_session_forbidden covers recent-auth; self-delete and final-admin guards tested. Frontend typed-confirmation dialog itself has no dedicated component test.

journeys.name: Prevent self-deletion / prevent deletion of final administrator
journeys.steps: Admin attempts self-delete; attempts to delete last admin
journeys.expected: Both rejected explicitly

journeys.name: Audit event creation
journeys.expected: Every privileged operation writes an audit event

journeys.name: Orphan-cleanup dry run
journeys.expected: Reports candidates without deleting; real run gated

journeys.name: Confirmation-token expiry
journeys.expected: Rejected; new token required
journeys.notes: Token-expiry path not located in the test suite; verify implementation and add a test.

journeys.name: Recovery procedure (deleted/corrupted account)
journeys.expected: Account data recoverable per RPO/RTO worksheet
journeys.notes: Procedure documented with an evidence template; no rehearsal record exists yet — do not claim validated until a rehearsal is logged.
